title: Machine learning derives a 23-gene ferroptosis signature in stage II/III colorectal cancer
summary: From 1,397 samples in nine datasets, a framework testing 83 combinations of 10 algorithms selected a 23-gene ferroptosis-related signature (Lasso with plsRcox) that predicted recurrence better than clinicopathological features and several published signatures. Four datasets were used for training and the rest for validation. The data are retrospective public cohorts without wet-lab confirmation.
ai_technology: Machine learning framework of 83 algorithm combinations; final Lasso plus plsRcox gene signature
organization: Shandong University; Qilu Hospital of Shandong University

evidence.tested: Training on four datasets and validation in the remaining independent datasets.
evidence.unknown: Clinical utility and biological mechanism are not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected the 23-gene prognostic signature among competing algorithm combinations.
